mainSubtitle: Whatever we build, we also sell. Ready to fly.

products.title: SpeedIK
products.description:
SpeedIK is our custom-designed and built speed drone with which we managed to break the world speed record for a drone under 250 g.

Want to fly really fast? SpeedIK is built for maximum speed and performance.

We also offer SpeedIK.L, our lightweight and more practical version of the SpeedIK. Unlike the original version, it uses connectors that allow you to repeat flights without the need for soldering and make component changes much easier.

In the box:
1x Drone
2x SIK LBS
4x CCW propellers
4x CW propellers

specs.GPS: GPS Module FLYWOO GOKU GM10 Nano V3.1
